coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF8711025), cross-referenced by position against an OpenStreetMap building/address point (way 255652150) for the name and street address; not a hand trace or plan estimate. The real, notable Edwin M. Lee Apartments (124,000 sq ft supportive-housing building for veterans and low-income families, 1150 3rd St, one block away) was investigated for this pass but its address point sits ~37m from this footprint's edge -- close enough to be the nearest available DataSF footprint, but not confidently its own separate outline in the building-footprint data checked. Left out rather than guessed; a future pass should re-check with a dedicated satellite/plan comparison.
